title: A meeting with representatives of the Resource Center for Migrants was held at BSU.

blocks.text: Today, a meeting with representatives of the Resource Center for Migrants — Golda Maira Roma, Ulan Kudaiberdiev and Raushan Bolotalieva — was held at Bishkek State University. The meeting was attended by BSU Rector Mirlan Dyldaev, Head of the Human Resources Department Astra Dairakunova and Head of the International Relations Department Edil Kanatbekov. Representatives of the Resource Center spoke about the goals and areas of their work. The Center is engaged in promoting the protection of the rights of migrants in target countries at all stages of migration. Its activities pay special attention to the prevention and counteraction of illegal migration, human trafficking and illegal smuggling of migrants. Also, as part of the cooperation, it is planned to conduct training sessions for teachers and students aimed at increasing legal literacy and awareness of migration issues.
